scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday's Little Explorers wetland walk able to use the advertised stroller-friendly north boardwalk loop.
Emerging Need: The route becomes useful after family interest and is later confirmed in the public program plan, but the required city gate escort is still not lined up.
Decision Context: Earlier generic planning does not justify reserving facilities help. A stored access procedure identifies when service-gate escort is mandatory, who handles it, and the Thursday cutoff.
Consequence: Timely, reversible coordination preserves the accessible loop without spending or promising approval; once the roster closes, the walk can continue only through the standard stepped overlook.

parameter.title: Little Explorers Wetland Walk
parameter.description: Tentative hold for an all-ages wetland walk; route and accessibility notes still pending.

parameter.subject: Preview package opened for Little Explorers walk
parameter.body: Communications has opened a preview package for Saturday's Little Explorers wetland walk. If route wording is still unsettled, the listing can stay generic until Thursday's program-details pass.

parameter.content: At today's library table, several caregivers asked whether the Saturday wetland walk would work with strollers. I noted that the route wasn't final yet and that no stroller-friendly loop had been promised.

parameter.title: Little Explorers Wetland Walk
parameter.description: Confirmed all-ages wetland walk. Public route note now lists the stroller-friendly north boardwalk loop via service gate B; volunteer route sheet still has the gate-escort line blank.
parameter.location: Brindlewood Park north boardwalk and shelter 2

parameter.subject: Saturday gate escort roster closed
parameter.body: For awareness, Facilities closed the Saturday maintenance-gate escort roster at 15:00. Programs not already on that roster should use standard public entrances this weekend; late additions won't be staffed.
